design_patterns.context: Separation of write operations (Django) from complex read operations (FastAPI/Analytics).
reasons_for_opting: Independent scaling of read and write workloads.
Optimized data schemas for high-performance dashboards (10k+ concurrent users).
Reduced contention on the primary relational database.

design_patterns.context: Asynchronous communication between Django and FastAPI via Redis/RabbitMQ.
reasons_for_opting: Decoupling of services; core functions remain active even if the AI service is busy.
Better responsiveness for long-running AI tasks (assessment generation).

design_patterns.context: Peripheral tasks like logging, security, and telemetry managed by secondary containers.
reasons_for_opting: Separation of concerns between business logic and infrastructure logic.
Consistent monitoring and security policies across different technology stacks (Django/FastAPI).
Simplified service-to-service communication via Service Mesh.

design_patterns.context: In-code interchangeability for evaluation algorithms and LLM providers.
reasons_for_opting: Extensibility for adding new AI models (GPT-4 vs Llama 3) without core changes.
Context-specific evaluation logic for different skill types (Soft Skills vs Technical).

design_patterns.context: Managing distributed transactions across Polyrepo services.
reasons_for_opting: Ensures data consistency without needing distributed locks.
Reliable cross-service workflows like Resource Deployment.
Clear compensation logic if a step in a multi-service process fails.
